definitions.explanation: Travel that takes place during nighttime hours, or a train/bus that operates overnight.
Being active at night, especially referring to animals that are nocturnal.

notes:
{夜行|やこう} has two main uses: overnight travel (sense 1) and nocturnal behavior (sense 2). It almost always appears as part of a compound rather than standing alone.

COMMON COMPOUNDS (travel):
- {夜行|やこう}⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧: overnight bus
- {夜行|やこう}⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧: night train
- {夜行|やこう}⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧: overnight flight/service

COMMON COMPOUNDS (biology):
- ⟦{夜行|やこう}{性|せい}→夜行性：16217_yakousei⟧: nocturnal (adjective for animals)
- ⟦{夜行|やこう}{性|せい}→夜行性：16217_yakousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: nocturnal animal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夜行|やこう} (overnight) vs ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧ (day trip)
- {夜行|やこう} (nocturnal) vs ⟦{昼行|ちゅうこう}{性|せい}→昼行性：24022_chuukousei⟧ (diurnal)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{夜行|やこう}⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧ is a popular budget travel option in Japan, especially among students. Routes connect major cities, departing late at night and arriving early in the morning.
